title: Split-Zero Geometry and Common Deformation Registers: Project Atlas, Exact Results, Formalization, and Visualizations
description:
This is the human-readable public home for a continuing mathematics project connecting explicit Erdos--Strauss arithmetic registers, split-zero and tagged-sedenion models, finite moonshine and Sigma(2,3,5) calculations, exact formal checks, and selected geometric experiments. The Project Atlas separates exact theorems, checked calculations, generated constructions, obstructions, diagnostics, and genuinely open interfaces.

The retained payload includes the Project Atlas, bookmarked result-packet compendium, Lean and Python sources, proof-status and axiom audits, machine-readable ledgers, editable working texts, visual sources, scene data, replay material, and the Part 8-C2B residual-Niemeier audit.

New bounded supplement: 07_Predatum_K4_Hopf_WorkingNotes_and_Checks_20260718.zip preserves the N16--N18 sequence on the K4 sphere, the terminology/typing charter, and the Hopf-fibration section-sheaf candidate, together with the cumulative lane ledger, executable scripts, recorded outputs, a fresh UTF-8 rerun, manifest, and hashes. The four script groups reran at 12/12, 17/17, 10/10, and 12/12 encoded checks. N17 explicitly contributes no new theorem; it fixes terminology and dependency direction.

Status. This is a working research record, not peer review, not a completed universal framework, and not a proof of a famous open problem. The script reruns certify only their encoded finite symbolic checks. Topos-level statements, bundle classification, cited topology, and the referee-recorded Gauss-linking computation remain identified external or non-machine-checked steps. The Project Atlas PDF remains the recommended entry point.
notes: The 2026-07-18 bounded supplement adds N16-N18 working notes and executable checks without changing the Project Atlas front PDF. The encoded scripts reran successfully, while external and non-machine-checked dependencies remain explicitly caveated. The concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20822444 resolves to the latest version.
